renames.NLAlib/LowRank/Nystrom.lean: Nystrom/Nystrom.lean would repeat the leaf name; the file defines `nystrom` and its structural identity, i.e. the leaf's definitions, so it becomes Nystrom/Basic.lean
renames.NLAlib/Estimation/Diagonal.lean: Diagonal/Diagonal.lean would repeat the leaf name; the file defines `rowSelector` and the stochastic diagonal estimator (the only file of the leaf), so it becomes Diagonal/Basic.lean

notes: Group M6 has 54 content files (39 LowRank, 10 Estimation, 5 Solvers), not 57: LowRank/Basic.lean, Solvers/Basic.lean and Estimation/Hutchinson.lean have no declarations (Basic files are docstring-only placeholders; Hutchinson.lean is a re-export of NLAlib.Concentration.QuadraticMoments kept for the old import path), so the script treats them as aggregators and they are not mapped. Estimation/Hutchinson.lean is imported by Estimation/HutchinsonLaws.lean; the apply step must redirect that import (to NLAlib.Concentration.QuadraticMoments's new path, M2's QuadraticForms) rather than to a regenerated aggregator.
No file outside LowRank/Estimation/Solvers imports any M6 file, so every M6 move only rewrites imports inside the group; all cross-leaf imports are inside the same top-level directory (layer 4 or 5).

Structural vs RangeFinding split: HMT 2011 §9 deterministic bounds (RangeFinder = Thm 9.1 Frobenius, PowerIteration = Prop 8.6 / Thm 9.2) go to Structural even though the brief lists 'power iteration' under RangeFinding; PowerIteration.lean is purely deterministic (no probability import). The expected-error results (HMT Thm 10.6 spectral in SpectralRangeFinder, Thm 10.7 in ExpectedPower, the one-row endpoint in GaussianSpectralEndpoints) go to RangeFinding.

RandomizedSVD gets the Chen-Persson thm:RSVD chain (Assembly scalar arithmetic, RSVD conditional theorem, GaussianSketch Gaussian instantiation, OptimalError relative to bestRankFrobSq). Nystrom gets the Nystrom and generalized Nystrom chain including the deterministic SketchedRegression identities (it defines `sketchedCore`/`sketchedOutput`, the GN estimator) and the raw-pseudoinverse GN bridge.

Cholesky gets real and complex RPCholesky wholesale (PartialCholesky, pivots, histories, expected-trace theorems) together with the scalar helpers TraceDrift and TracePotential, which have no matrix content but exist only for the RPCholesky recursion (manuscript sa:rp-recursion / sa:rp-theorem).
Sampling gets volume sampling wholesale (real and complex) including the purely combinatorial VolumeCounting.

Estimation/QuadraticForms receives HutchinsonLaws (mean and variance of a single quadratic form z^T A z under concrete Gaussian/Rademacher laws), deviating from the brief's 'Hutchinson* -> Trace'; the multi-sample estimator files (HutchinsonTail defines `hutchinsonEstimate`; Unbiased covers Hutchinson, Hutch++, XTrace) go to Trace. If the reviewer prefers the literal brief, move HutchinsonLaws to Trace; QuadraticForms is then empty.
Estimation/Quadrature gets the six SLQ files wholesale.
Solvers: four Kaczmarz files to Kaczmarz, SketchProject to SketchAndProject; SketchAndSolve and Preconditioning stay empty (no file in Solvers today has that content).
Coordinator: docstring-only Basic files deleted; Hutchinson re-export shim kept in Estimation/Trace; RandomStart* moved to the new leaf Estimation/Spectral.
flags: NLAlib/LowRank/SpectralRangeFinder.lean: mixes the deterministic spectral HMT Thm 9.1 (sub_mul_pinvR_mul_transpose_eq, specNorm_residual_sq_le_of_range_subset, specNorm_residual_le_of_range_subset, lines 64-160) with the Gaussian expected spectral error HMT Thm 10.6 (lines 162-453, the bulk); placed in RangeFinding; split later so the deterministic part joins Structural next to RangeFinder.lean.

NLAlib/LowRank/GaussianSketch.lean: mixes the Gaussian instantiation of RSVD (rsvd_main_gaussian, rsvd_truncated_main_gaussian) with that of generalized Nystrom (completion_reduction_gaussian, gn_main_gaussian, measurable_frobSq_sub_sketchedOutput); placed in RandomizedSVD (RSVD part comes first and OptimalError/SpectralRangeFinder import it for the RSVD part); split later, GN half to Nystrom.

NLAlib/LowRank/Assembly.lean: scalar expectation arithmetic for both thm:RSVD (rsvd_assembly, rsvd_explicit) and thm:GN (gn_assembly, gn_explicit) plus a generic Jensen lemma integral_le_sqrt_integral_sq (a Probability/Moments fact); placed in RandomizedSVD; split later (GN half to Nystrom, Jensen lemma down to Probability).

NLAlib/LowRank/SubspaceConvergence.lean, ComplexSubspaceConvergence.lean, ComplexSubspaceAngles.lean: magnitude-gap convergence of subspace iteration and principal-angle tangents (Saad 2011 §5.1), with no probability content; they overlap NLAlib/Krylov/SubspaceIteration.lean (M5 -> Krylov/Spectral) and their imports (Matrix, Krylov.Block, Krylov.ComplexBlock) allow layer 1; placed in LowRank/RangeFinding as the closest LowRank leaf; candidates to move to Krylov/Spectral in coordination with M5.

NLAlib/LowRank/RandomStartPower.lean, RandomStartLanczos.lean, RandomStartEndpoints.lean: expected relative error of the largest-eigenvalue estimate by random-start power and Lanczos (Kuczynski-Wozniakowski 1992); this is eigenvalue/norm estimation, not low-rank approximation, and fits no listed leaf; they import Gaussian log-overlap moments, so they cannot go to Krylov (layer 1). Placed together in LowRank/RangeFinding; propose a new leaf Estimation/Spectral (randomized norm and extreme-eigenvalue estimation) to hold them.

NLAlib/LowRank/PowerIteration.lean: the brief lists power iteration under RangeFinding, but this file is HMT Prop 8.6 / Thm 9.2 with no randomness, so it went to Structural; move to RangeFinding if the brief is to be followed literally.

NLAlib/Estimation/HutchinsonTail.lean: besides the Hutchinson tail it carries general helpers (specNorm_le_of_forall_sum_sq_mulVec_le and specNorm_blockDiagonal_const_le are Matrix/Norms facts; hasSubgaussianMGF_of_isStandardGaussian is a Probability/SubGaussian fact); placed in Trace; relocate the helpers in the later housekeeping pass.

NLAlib/Estimation/Unbiased.lean: ends with integral_integral_spectralMeasure_eq_trace (the SLQ/spectral-measure unbiasedness, Quadrature topic) after the Hutch++/XTrace content; placed in Trace; split later.

NLAlib/Estimation/HutchinsonLaws.lean: placed in QuadraticForms on content (mean/variance of one quadratic form under concrete laws) rather than Trace as the brief's 'Hutchinson*' pattern suggests; reviewer's call.
